title: Irish Beef Stir Fry
description: A hearty and flavorful beef stir fry that's gluten-free and easy to make.

ingredients.name: Nutty Oil (e.g., peanut or walnut oil)
Stir-Fry Sauce (gluten-free)
ingredients.notes: Make sure to choose a gluten-free option.

instructions: Heat the nutty oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 135°F (57°C) for medium-rare.
Remove the beef from the skillet and set it aside to rest.
Add the carrots and onions to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until they're tender-crisp.
Return the beef to the skillet and stir in the stir-fry sauce.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened.
Serve the beef and vegetables hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Let the beef rest for a few minutes before slicing it thinly against the grain.
